title: U: Add explicit local-only Tolra Demo seed
public_pr_body:
Superseded by #243 (Claude Code’s demo-data seed, proved on a disposable CI database). No further work on U in this PR.

Add an explicit, local-only Tolra Demo screenshot seed and plain instructions in tests/demo/README.md. Plans Example Customer A/B/C, three fake jobs/invoices (paid, due, overdue), two machines, three machine-time rows and normal audit activity. All names, example.test emails and integer-pence prices are invented. No production/customer records are copied.

Assumption: safest target is a fresh dedicated native-loopback database named tolra_demo_throwaway with zero companies, not an existing shared test or generic postgres database. URL and actual server database/address/role are independently checked; explicit confirmation is required. The local fake Demo Owner Auth fixture must exist first. No auth passwords/keys are generated or stored in code. The existing company creator grants its membership.

One transaction, scoped to the newly created company; failure rolls back. Refuse existing companies/repeats rather than erase/overwrite. No migration runner, trigger disabling, external calls or integration connects. Plan mode never loads pg or opens a connection.

Validation: plan-only CLI ran; 5 fake-client unit tests, typecheck, targeted lint and diff check passed. THE WRITER WAS NOT RUN: no database SQL, real schema/runtime, browser or screenshot validation. Operator prerequisites and the exact opt-in command are documented for later review. Draft from main 68f89ca; no deployment, merge or Ready label.
